question.problem: Expressed as a mixed number in its lowest terms, $2÷\frac{6}{7}=${{field-1}}.
question.worked_solution:
Dividing a whole number by a fraction is equivalent to multiplying the whole number by the reciprocal of the fraction.

First, we write $2$ as an improper fraction:

$$
2=\frac{2}{1}
$$

Next, we note that the reciprocal of $\frac{6}{7}$ is $\frac{7}{6}.$ 

So, we have

$$
2÷\frac{6}{7}=\frac{2}{1}÷\frac{6}{7}=\frac{2}{1}\times \frac{7}{6}.
$$

 

Now, we multiply our fractions. Note that we can simplify the process by swapping the denominators first.

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{2}{1}\times \frac{7}{6} & =\frac{2}{6}\times \frac{7}{1} \\  & =\frac{1}{3}\times 7 \\  & =\frac{7}{3}\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we convert our result to a mixed number:

$$
\frac{7}{3}=2\,\text{R}\,1=2\,\frac{1}{3}
$$
